response.quote_a: Those Headmasters (Gr.II) who have completed five (5) academic years of service in a particular school as on the date of closure of Academic Year i.e 31 st May of that Year shall be transferred compulsorily.
response.quote_b: Headmasters Gr.II shall be shifted only after completing six academic years in the school.
response.explanation: Document A mandates compulsory transfer for Headmasters Gr.II after five academic years of service, while Document B states they shall only be shifted after completing six academic years.
